title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Miller soundboard transfer captures a legendary ’70 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑fixed soundboard source is praised as crystal‑clear and well balanced, delivering a listenable record of one of the most celebrated 1970 concerts.  Fans rave about the monster second electric set – Dark Star, The Other One, Lovelight and Smokestack Lightning are repeatedly called all‑time greats, with Pigpen’s rare guitar moment on Katie Mae adding extra sparkle.  Overall the three‑set marathon is regarded as a quintessential Dead performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 90% of reviews are 5‑star, many detailed praises of both performance and the Miller transfer; only a single low or neutral rating. Weighted average yields an excellent score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller fix transfer described as "most excellent", strong, clear and balanced with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon with a tight acoustic first set, a monster second electric set that many call the pinnacle of ’70 shows, and a solid closing third set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work receives universal praise – his tone and improvisations on Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight are highlighted as exceptional.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is noted for locking in with Pigpen during jams, providing a solid foundation throughout the set.
